title: Removal Minimum for Not-Performed and Duplicate Test Credits on Coordination Corrections — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — coordination corrections (CO-22).** The coordination correction's removal minimum is the total that not-performed and duplicate-test credits on the order must reach before they come off a coordination claim.

## Rule

The coordination correction's removal minimum is:

- the contracted removal minimum of **50.00 USD** where the payer class writes billed charges down to a contracted allowance and the plan adjudicated at least one line of the claim to a contractual adjustment;
- the non-contracted removal minimum of **100.00 USD** where the payer class does not write charges down and the plan adjudicated at least one line of the claim to a contractual adjustment;
- the standard removal minimum of **200.00 USD** otherwise, that is, where the claim carries no contractual-adjustment line.

## Which payer classes write charges down

| Payer class | Writes billed charges down to a contracted allowance |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | Yes |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | Yes |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | Yes |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | Yes |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | Yes |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | Yes |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | No |

## Combinations

| Payer class writes down | Contractual-adjustment line on the claim | Removal minimum |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 50.00 |
| No | Yes | 100.00 |
| Yes | No | 200.00 |
| No | No | 200.00 |

**Hypothetical.** A Commercial Out-of-Network Plan claim carrying a contractual-adjustment line: removal minimum 100.00 USD, so not-performed credits of 80.00 USD do not reach it.
